# AmiFit

Offline micronutrient tracker for iPhone.

You probably have a nutrient gap. You just don't know which one. AmiFit tells you. No account. No internet. No servers. Use it in airplane mode if you want.

## What you actually get

You probably have a nutrient gap. You just don't know which one.

- What's my Omega-6 to Omega-3 ratio right now?
- Do I get enough B12?
- How much iron have I gotten this week?
- Do I get enough Vitamin D from what I eat?
- Have I had enough magnesium this week?

AmiFit tells you. No account. No internet. No servers. Use it in airplane mode if you want.

See what you're missing. Literally.

## What it does

Find out what you're missing in minutes — vitamins, minerals, EPA+DHA, and the Omega-6:3 ratio most apps have never heard of.

Macros are the past. Micros are the future.

## How food logging works

AI scanning is amazing, but you never know if the weight it guesses is right. And a food scale works, but it's a pain.

There's a third option. Real photos of real portions in your pocket. You'll know what 275g of cheeseburger looks like. Most people don't.

Every photo in the app is original — personally photographed and weighed with real portions. No stock images. Search a food, see actual photographs at common portions, tap the one that looks like your plate, and the grams are set automatically. If you had two of that serving, increase the count. If you'd rather estimate manually, compare your plate to the photo and enter grams directly.

The displayed weight reflects the edible portion only — peels, bones, seeds, and shells excluded.

You can also create custom foods with full nutritional detail and share them between devices using a built-in QR code export. No internet needed for that either.

I don't photograph my food. I just eat it.

## Nutrients tracked (48)

- **Macros**: Protein, Carbohydrate, Fat, Fiber, Sugar
- **Fats**: Saturated Fat, Trans Fat, Monounsaturated Fat, Polyunsaturated Fat
- **Omegas**: ALA, EPA, DHA, EPA+DHA combined, Omega-6, Omega-6:3 Ratio
- **Minerals**: Calcium, Phosphorus, Potassium, Magnesium, Sodium, Iron, Zinc, Copper, Manganese, Selenium
- **Vitamins**: A, D, E, K, C, B1 (Thiamine), B2 (Riboflavin), B3 (Niacin), B5 (Pantothenic Acid), B6, Folate (B9), B12
- **Choline**
- **Amino acids (all 9 essential)**: Histidine, Isoleucine, Leucine, Lysine, Methionine+Cystine, Phenylalanine+Tyrosine, Threonine, Tryptophan, Valine
- **Other**: Cholesterol, Alcohol, Water

## Privacy

Offline. No account ever created.

AmiFit is a local app: all your data lives on your iPhone. There are no accounts to create, no servers storing your information, and no way for us to see what you do. Your nutrition data, health information, goals, and everything else you enter stays on your iPhone and nowhere else.

To delete everything, simply delete the app. There is nothing on our end to remove.

Offline is the new black. Use it in the mountains. Use it in the metro.

## Pricing

Use it for free. Track your calories, protein, carbohydrate, and fat for free. No functionality is locked. Premium only shows you more nutrients.

- **Premium**: €7.49 per month. Cancel anytime through the App Store.
- **Lifetime**: €99 one-time. With Lifetime, no more checking Apple's servers to verify your subscription.

No free trial. The free version is fully functional for macro tracking and gives a complete picture of how the app works before any upgrade.

The offline app for people who are online enough already.

## Requirements

- iOS 18 or later.
- Runs on any iPhone that supports iOS 18, including older models like iPhone XR and iPhone SE (3rd generation).
- Single-device design. AmiFit does not sync between devices in real time. iCloud Backup transfers data to a new device on the same Apple ID, but ongoing changes do not propagate live across devices.

## How to get it

The easiest way to do this: grab your iPhone. Go to the App Store. Search AmiFit. Download it. If you don't have an iPhone, consider getting one.
